answer: An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the canyon ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the comet checkpoint rather than self-declared, the vault audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm thus means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
